review_type: Independent bounded HTTP implementation source re-review
requirements: FR-APP-023 AC-3 AC-4 AC-5 AC-7 AC-8

evidence: HttpExecution holds registered=true through cleaning and releasing. The initial cleanup no longer unconditionally removes the lifecycle identity after closeBody.

cleanupIfIdle marks cleaned/cleaning under state, performs upload/input cleanup outside state, clears cleaning and calls releaseIfIdle. releaseIfIdle checks owner, queue and Deferred leases again under state before release.

A callback admitted during closeBody keeps the same existing registration and sets owner under state. On old cleanup completion, owner or a returned Deferred lease prevents release/unregister. A callback that exits during cleaning cannot unregister because cleaning remains true.

Admission and unregister both hold state; unregister flips registered and removes the identity without an interleaving admission. Once an idle request is unregistered, a later RUNNING callback registers before becoming owner. Lifecycle closed/cancelled/ABORTED gates still reject forbidden late work.

The release hook executes outside state with releasing=true and registration retained. Synchronous/reentrant or concurrent callbacks can run; final idle recheck prevents unregister of an active owner/lease. Later idle cleanup observes transportReleased and removes registration without calling the hook again.
Retained original input is cleaned exactly once; later work never resets cleaned/transportReleased or reacquires input/transport retention. No generation can repeat old cleanup.
Per-RouterCursor and per-RouteCursor ++sync>100 boundaries and own-callback reset remain unchanged from reviewed4be fix. Global depth64 has not returned.
Existing exact pinned11 depth traces, mixed70+70,1500-stack and cross-thread controls remain included in supplied regression evidence.

coordinator_regression_checks: retainRequest acquired before lifecycle registration, onAbort subscription and middleware execution; closed-lifecycle path cancels and releases acquired hold.
cancel marks cancelled and clears queued work/leases under state before response.abort, so synchronous abort-listener reentry returns immediately. Active owner delays cleanup until callback return.
Response completion listener is once-only. cancellation after an already completed response still revokes work and invokes idle cleanup without duplicate response abort/log.
releaseRequest exceptions are caught; finally marks transportReleased, clears releasing and unregisters if idle. Even logger failure cannot bypass finally bookkeeping.

releaseUploads failure still enters closeBody finally and coordinator finalization. Blocking input close/release hooks occur outside request state monitor; lifecycle membership bookkeeping invokes no user hooks.
AppLifecycle.cancelHttp snapshots membership under its monitor then invokes cancel outside it, avoiding reverse lock acquisition against state->membership admission/removal.
